```{python}
# The report only reads dbt models: business rules stay in dbt, never here.
import duckdb
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

con = duckdb.connect("../data/saas.duckdb", read_only=True)

MONTHS = ["janvier", "février", "mars", "avril", "mai", "juin", "juillet", "août", "septembre", "octobre", "novembre", "décembre"]
BLUE = "#2a78d6"
ORANGE = "#eb6834"
plotly_loaded = False


def euros(value):
    return f"{value:,.0f}".replace(",", " ") + " €"


def percent(value):
    return f"{value * 100:.1f}".replace(".", ",") + " %"


def month_name(day):
    return MONTHS[day.month - 1]


def long_date(day):
    return f"{day.day} {month_name(day)} {day.year}"


def show_chart(figure, description):
    # Plotly's script loads once, with the first chart of the page.
    global plotly_loaded
    figure.update_layout(template="plotly_white", separators=", ", margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=30, b=10))
    chart = figure.to_html(
        full_html=False,
        include_plotlyjs=False if plotly_loaded else "cdn",
        config={"displayModeBar": False, "responsive": True},
    )
    plotly_loaded = True
    display(HTML(f'<div role="img" aria-label="{description}">{chart}</div>'))


billed_total = con.execute("select sum(billed_amount_eur) from analytics_marts.mart_monthly_billing").fetchone()[0]
closing_mrr = con.execute("select closing_mrr_eur from analytics_marts.mart_monthly_mrr order by mrr_month desc limit 1").fetchone()[0]
customers = con.execute("""
    select d.customer_name, sum(b.billed_amount_eur) as billed_amount_eur
    from analytics_marts.mart_customer_monthly_billing as b
    inner join analytics_marts.dim_customers as d
        on b.customer_id = d.customer_id
    group by 1
    order by 2
""").fetchall()
open_invoices = con.execute("""
    select d.customer_name, o.invoice_date, o.due_date, o.amount_eur, o.days_overdue, o.aging_bucket, o.closing_date
    from analytics_marts.mart_open_invoices as o
    inner join analytics_marts.dim_customers as d
        on o.customer_id = d.customer_id
    order by o.days_overdue desc, o.invoice_date, d.customer_name
""").fetchall()
payments = con.execute("""
    select d.customer_name, p.paid_invoice_count, p.total_days_to_pay, p.avg_days_to_pay, p.late_paid_invoice_count
    from analytics_marts.mart_customer_payment_behavior as p
    inner join analytics_marts.dim_customers as d
        on p.customer_id = d.customer_id
    order by p.avg_days_to_pay
""").fetchall()
open_total = sum(invoice[3] for invoice in open_invoices)
overdue_total = sum(invoice[3] for invoice in open_invoices if invoice[4] > 0)
paid_count = sum(row[1] for row in payments)
late_count = sum(row[4] for row in payments)
average_days = sum(row[2] for row in payments) / paid_count
top_name, top_amount = customers[-1]

tiles = [
    ("Facturé sur la période", euros(billed_total)),
    (f"MRR fin {month_name(con.execute('select max(mrr_month) from analytics_marts.mart_monthly_mrr').fetchone()[0])}", euros(closing_mrr)),
    ("Factures en retard", euros(overdue_total)),
    ("Délai moyen de paiement", f"{average_days:.0f}\u00a0jours"),
]
display(HTML(
    '<div class="tiles">'
    + "".join(f'<div class="tile"><div class="tile-label">{label}</div><div class="tile-value">{value}</div></div>' for label, value in tiles)
    + "</div>"
))
```

## Pourquoi le facturé dépasse-t-il parfois le MRR ?

```{python}
rows = con.execute("""
    select b.invoice_month, b.billed_amount_eur, m.closing_mrr_eur
    from analytics_marts.mart_monthly_billing as b
    inner join analytics_marts.mart_monthly_mrr as m
        on b.invoice_month = m.mrr_month
    order by 1
""").fetchall()
gaps = [f"{month_name(row[0])} ({euros(row[1] - row[2])})" for row in rows if row[1] > row[2]]

display(Markdown(
    "Le MRR mesure ce qui se répète chaque mois, alors que le facturé inclut aussi les factures ponctuelles. "
    f"L'écart apparaît en {' et en '.join(gaps)}."
))

labels = [month_name(row[0]) for row in rows]
figure = go.Figure()
figure.add_scatter(x=labels, y=[float(row[1]) for row in rows], name="Facturé", mode="lines+markers", line=dict(color=BLUE, width=2), hovertemplate="%{y:,.0f} €")
figure.add_scatter(x=labels, y=[float(row[2]) for row in rows], name="MRR", mode="lines+markers", line=dict(color=ORANGE, width=2, dash="dash"), hovertemplate="%{y:,.0f} €")
figure.update_layout(height=320, hovermode="x unified", yaxis=dict(rangemode="tozero", ticksuffix=" €"), legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.12))
show_chart(figure, "Courbes mensuelles du facturé et du MRR")
```

## Comment évolue le revenu récurrent ?

```{python}
movements = con.execute("""
    select
        mrr_month,
        opening_mrr_eur,
        new_mrr_eur + expansion_mrr_eur + reactivation_mrr_eur as gains_eur,
        contraction_mrr_eur + churned_mrr_eur as losses_eur,
        closing_mrr_eur,
        closing_customer_count,
        gross_mrr_churn_rate
    from analytics_marts.mart_monthly_mrr
    order by mrr_month
""").fetchall()
worst = min(movements, key=lambda row: row[3])

if worst[3] < 0:
    display(Markdown(
        "Un total stable peut cacher un départ. "
        f"En {month_name(worst[0])}, le revenu récurrent perd {euros(-worst[3])}, soit {percent(worst[6])} de son niveau d'ouverture."
    ))

table = [
    "| Mois | Ouverture | Gains | Pertes | Clôture | Clients | Part perdue |",
    "|:---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
]
for row in movements:
    lost = "n/a" if row[6] is None else percent(row[6])
    table.append(f"| {month_name(row[0]).capitalize()} | {euros(row[1])} | {euros(row[2])} | {euros(row[3])} | {euros(row[4])} | {row[5]} | {lost} |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(table)))
```

## Quels clients pèsent le plus dans le facturé ?

```{python}
display(Markdown(f"{top_name} représente {percent(top_amount / billed_total)} du montant facturé sur la période."))

figure = go.Figure()
figure.add_bar(
    x=[float(customer[1]) for customer in customers],
    y=[customer[0] for customer in customers],
    orientation="h",
    marker=dict(color=BLUE, cornerradius=4),
    text=[euros(customer[1]) for customer in customers],
    textposition="outside",
    cliponaxis=False,
    hovertemplate="%{y} : %{x:,.0f} €<extra></extra>",
)
figure.update_layout(height=300, xaxis=dict(visible=False, range=[0, float(top_amount) * 1.18]), yaxis=dict(automargin=True))
show_chart(figure, "Barres du montant facturé par client")
```

## Quelles factures sont en retard ?

```{python}
closing_date = open_invoices[0][6]
display(Markdown(
    f"Au {long_date(closing_date)}, {euros(open_total)} restent à encaisser, dont {euros(overdue_total)} en retard."
))

buckets = {
    "not_due": "Pas encore échu",
    "1_30_days": "1 à 30 jours de retard",
    "31_60_days": "31 à 60 jours de retard",
    "61_90_days": "61 à 90 jours de retard",
    "over_90_days": "Plus de 90 jours de retard",
}
table = ["| Tranche | Factures | Montant |", "|:---|---:|---:|"]
for bucket, label in buckets.items():
    amounts = [invoice[3] for invoice in open_invoices if invoice[5] == bucket]
    table.append(f"| {label} | {len(amounts)} | {euros(sum(amounts))} |")
table.append(f"| **Total** | **{len(open_invoices)}** | **{euros(open_total)}** |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(table)))
```

```{python}
table = ["| Client | Facture | Échéance | Montant | Retard |", "|:---|:---|:---|---:|---:|"]
for name, invoice_date, due, amount, days_overdue, _, _ in open_invoices:
    delay = f"{days_overdue} jours" if days_overdue > 0 else "Non échue"
    table.append(f"| {name} | {long_date(invoice_date)} | {long_date(due)} | {euros(amount)} | {delay} |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(table)))
```

## En combien de jours nos clients paient-ils ?

```{python}
term_days = con.execute("select max(due_date - invoice_date) from analytics_marts.fct_invoices").fetchone()[0]

display(Markdown(
    f"En moyenne, nos clients paient en {average_days:.0f} jours, pour une échéance à {term_days} jours. "
    f"{late_count} factures sur {paid_count} ont été payées en retard. "
    "En orange, les clients dont le délai moyen dépasse l'échéance."
))

figure = go.Figure()
figure.add_bar(
    x=[float(row[3]) for row in payments],
    y=[row[0] for row in payments],
    orientation="h",
    marker=dict(color=[ORANGE if row[3] > term_days else BLUE for row in payments], cornerradius=4),
    text=[f"{row[3]:.0f} jours" for row in payments],
    # Labels sit at the start of the bars, clear of the due date line.
    textposition="inside",
    insidetextanchor="start",
    textfont=dict(color="white"),
    hovertemplate="%{y} : %{x:.0f} jours<extra></extra>",
)
figure.add_vline(x=term_days, line=dict(color="#52514e", width=1, dash="dash"), annotation_text="Échéance", annotation_position="top")
figure.update_layout(height=300, xaxis=dict(visible=False, range=[0, float(payments[-1][3]) * 1.05]), yaxis=dict(automargin=True))
show_chart(figure, "Barres du délai moyen de paiement par client, avec l'échéance en repère")
```

::: {.report-note}
Le montant facturé inclut les factures payées et en attente, et exclut les factures annulées. Les données sont fictives, et ce rapport ne constitue pas un document comptable. Le code et les définitions sont sur [GitHub](https://github.com/MelvinBrdt/saas-revenue-analytics).
:::
